mathematics.generic: Two saturated connected chains with disjoint supports and no connecting edge remain actual components after either switch; their physical switches commute. Ambient graph, palette, and chain lengths are unrestricted.
mathematics.consumer: The supplied exterior from the radius-two obstruction repairs in two physical switches supported inside radius three. Both orders reach the same full colouring and every intermediate state fixes the farther exterior.
mathematics.radius_lower_bound: LocalRepairRadius.no_local_extension; no full endpoint fixing the exterior outside radius two.
mathematics.spatial_semantics: Every changed exterior vertex in both histories has a verified route of at most three graph edges from the deleted core; this is not only membership in a named finite set.

cost_scope: Successful incremental frontend times rounded by Lake; imported modules excluded. No whole-proof runtime saving is claimed.
limits: No universal radius-three or two-switch repair bound.
No supply theorem for the two supports or compatible starting colouring.
